name: The Grove at Shrewsbury
summary: The Grove at Shrewsbury is an upscale lifestyle center in Monmouth County, New Jersey, featuring premium wellness and retail brands including newly opened Alo and upcoming Solidcore fitness studio. This open-air plaza offers a sophisticated shopping and dining experience tailored to health-conscious, affluent consumers seeking quality lifestyle amenities.
demographics: The Grove at Shrewsbury attracts an affluent, health-conscious demographic primarily consisting of upper-middle-class families and professionals from Monmouth County, New Jersey. The trade area includes households with above-average incomes, typically ranging from $100,000 to $200,000+ annually, with a strong presence of dual-income families and educated professionals aged 30-55. Visitors demonstrate a preference for premium fitness, wellness, and lifestyle brands, as evidenced by tenants like Alo and Solidcore, indicating a market segment that prioritizes quality experiences and health-focused retail over traditional big-box shopping.
description: The Grove at Shrewsbury is a premier lifestyle shopping destination located at 597 Broad Street in Shrewsbury, New Jersey, offering a curated mix of upscale retail, dining, and wellness experiences. This open-air plaza has established itself as a sophisticated gathering place for Monmouth County residents seeking premium brands and lifestyle amenities in an inviting outdoor setting. The center features an evolving tenant mix that reflects contemporary consumer preferences, with recent additions including Alo, the popular activewear and wellness brand that opened with an exclusive early access event and grand opening celebration in January 2026, and Solidcore, a science-based fitness studio scheduled to open at Grove West in Spring 2026. The plaza also houses unique concepts like The Studio and The Chameleon, contributing to its distinctive character. With convenient hours Monday through Friday 10-7, Saturday 10-6, and Sunday 11-5, The Grove at Shrewsbury continues to enhance its offerings while maintaining its reputation as a premier destination for discerning shoppers seeking quality, wellness, and community in the heart of Monmouth County.
